name: Yaochou Seigikan
source:
I was a sumo rikishi with aspirations to become yokozuna.
My rivals sent me email threats to throw the game... or else.
In the email, my girlfriend, mother, and sisters were all getting raped!
Can I make it through these epic bouts of cuckoldry to become a winner?!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE073604.html]DLsite english[/url]]
translation:
我是一个立志成为横纲的相扑力士。我的对手发来邮件威胁我故意输掉比赛……否则后果自负。邮件里，我的女朋友、母亲和姐妹们都在被强奸！我能在这些绿帽大战中挺过来成为赢家吗！？

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE073604.html]DLsite English[/url]]
